acip: GNYIS PA NI, NANG SDE GNAS MA BU PAS, GANG ZAG RTAG GCIG RANG DBANG CAN GYI KHYAD PAR GSUM PO DES STONG PA GANG ZAG GI BDAG MED PHRA MOR 'DOD LA,
wylie: gnyis pa ni, nang sde gnas ma bu pas, gang zag rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi khyad par gsum po des stong pa gang zag gi bdag med phra mor 'dod la
english: Which brings us to our second point here: what it means when we say that something is empty of existing in a self-standing, substantial way.  Now the inner belief system of the followers of Vatsiputra describes the subtle lack of a self-nature to the person as the person's emptiness of three different details: existing in an unchanging way; existing as something singular; and existing as something which is independent.
